id: title:Gilbert09:add search aliases for google sheets and bigquery connectors

review.posthog_relevance: Adds warehouse ingestion configuration options for BigQuery and Google Sheets, allowing users to discover and select these sources via search keywords and metadata labels in the settings UI.
review.reason: The change adds search keywords and metadata to BigQuery and Google Sheets warehouse source configurations. P1.F1.H1 adds keywords ['bq', 'gbq'] and metadata to BigQuery configuration. P1.F2.H1 adds keywords ['gsheet', 'gsheets', 'spreadsheet', 'google sheet'], a label, and documentation reference to Google Sheets configuration. This is a narrow, localized maintenance and usability
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed code changes, but the actual benefit and user adoption are not demonstrated. The tier is assigned based on the observed code changes, but the actual benefit and user adoption are not demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F1.H1 adds search keywords and metadata to BigQuery source configuration. P1.F2.H1 adds search keywords, a label, and documentation reference to Google Sheets source configuration. No tier assignment is made here; this is an observation-only step.
